details:
Description

When a specific loading screen is selected, its audio is noticeably louder than the audio of other loading screens.

Furthermore, the audio from this loading screen remains audible even when the VRChat Master Volume is set to 0%. Normally, setting the Master Volume to 0% should mute all audio in VRChat, but the audio from this loading screen continues to be audible.

I have tried clearing the cache, verifying the integrity of the game files, and reinstalling VRChat, but none of these resolved the issue.

Reproduction Steps

1. Launch VRChat.

2. Set the loading screen that causes the issue.

3. Travel to another world or otherwise trigger the loading screen.

4. Observe that the loading screen audio is noticeably louder than the audio of other loading screens.

5. Set the VRChat Master Volume to 0%.

6. Confirm that the audio from the affected loading screen is still audible even with the Master Volume set to 0%.

Workaround:

I have not found an effective workaround at this time. Changing to a different loading screen avoids the issue.

Details

- Category: オーディオ

- Frequency: Always
